verdict.root_cause: The only substantiated abnormality is a configuration value: at 05:15:10, ~6 minutes before the 05:21 alert, platform-automation set paymentservice's OTLP traces exporter endpoint to a loopback address on port 4317 where no in-pod collector listens (tr_0523b5288237). The hostname change across the log gap (tr_a2a5e76337b4) indicates a container replacement between 05:11:19 and 05:24:12, consistent with the pod restarting to adopt that variable. But the payment request path itself is clean: error ratio is flat zero across the window on two independent queries (tr_785dc1362a64, tr_524fff9f82ca), charges complete in ~1ms on both sides of the gap (tr_004671248776), and every Charge span is sub-millisecond and unerrored (tr_05d27c7b7cdc). So the mechanism I can name is the misconfigured exporter endpoint itself — a value pointed at nothing, degrading telemetry and forcing a restart — not payment-tier failure. The critical multi-service severity almost certainly lives on the two unmeasured edges and is not settled here.
verdict.reasoning: The exporter endpoint is wrong as a value — it names an unreachable address — and that wrongness is the mechanism, so bad_config over the alternatives. bad_deploy is out: the sole in-window change is an env-var update, no image or version rollout (tr_0523b5288237). dependency_latency is out for paymentservice: a blocking exporter would slow the call path, yet Charge spans are ~0.3ms and checkout's time sits in the shipping-quote leg (tr_05d27c7b7cdc). resource_exhaustion is unsupported: no memory, CPU, pool, or restart-count data was returned at all (tr_524fff9f82ca). Confidence is low because every symptom probe aimed at paymentservice came back healthy; the causal link to the critical severity rests on temporal proximity and sole-change-in-window. The cart corpus warning that flat-zero errors can mean 'not reached' does not apply, since logs and traces show payment actively serving.
open_questions: What are the other two services in the blast radius and what is their behaviour? No dispatch left paymentservice, so the critical severity is unexplained.
The 05:18:00-05:22:30 interval around the alert was elided by truncation in both log queries (tr_004671248776, tr_a2a5e76337b4); no exporter or connection-refused line was ever actually observed.
Was the pod replacement a config-driven rolling restart or a crash/OOM? No restart-count, memory, or CPU series was returned (tr_524fff9f82ca).
